files.method: Read all 24 ordered-key schemas and 11 source/root/SHA mappings.
Read every assigned tuple and all scalar values; exact_node references reuse canonical subtrees by the peer-provided mapping. Nodes 1-400 are assigned to recent_research.

findings: Updated weather_v1/router manifests explicitly document one evaluation per station/date/bracket, non-overlapping CV windows, true lead-1 inputs; shown station evaluation counts fall from 28616 to 3822.

The six-station map replaces KJFK with KNYC. The fitted training range changes from 2024-04-01 through 2025-03-31 (365 samples,292 overlapping folds) to 2024-11-01 through 2026-06-30 (607 samples,39 folds,14-session step). This changes evidence semantics and must not be presented as a pure strategy improvement on identical data.

Router choices become five NGR and one raw (KMIA); all selected models have negative Brier improvement versus NDFD. Examples: KLAX changes from +40.79 raw to -19.74 NGR; KMDW from -51.14 raw to -50.17 NGR. Choosing the less bad local model does not establish benchmark edge.

Legacy reforecast artifact is removed and includes negative-bankroll/drawdown-over100% anomalies: KJFK final -0.01/max drawdown122.65%; KLAX final -0.24/max drawdown100.05%; KMIA max drawdown103.37%. These are historical generated artifacts, not new verified market returns.

New calibration-at-median summaries often qualify only1-2 of10 bins at minimum100 samples; a PASS is limited coverage, not evidence every bucket is calibrated. Training residual sigma KLAX increases from1.35876 to2.92108 degreesF, consistent with removing the invalid lead-time shortcut described in the branch source/docs.

Regenerated manifests retain huge synthetic-market ROI values while failing NDFD benchmark improvement. No annual-profit target or live trade promotion follows from these files. The branch and generated artifacts are preserved in main history by exact ancestry.
limits: Semantic JSON review preserves every assigned value with schema/node mappings; does not claim manual review of repeated pretty-print whitespace, peer-assigned nodes1-400, or raw vendor observations. No trading/model code executed.
